title: Velvety Polish Chocolate Bake
description: A rich and cozy Polish dessert featuring charred, velvety plain chocolate and bhuna spices, made with gluten-free-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour and bhuna spice mix.
In a large bowl, melt the chocolate in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Add the melted chocolate to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
Add the flour mixture to the chocolate mixture and whisk until just combined.
Pour in the heavy cream and melted butter, and whisk until the batter is smooth.
Pour the batter into a 20cm round baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
